concepts.title: Activation Procedure
concepts.description: Outlines the activation procedure, preconditions, traffic impact, and CLI commands for Data-Aware Carrier Management.

concepts.title: DEACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Details the steps, rancli commands, and operational impact for deactivating Data-Aware Carrier Management.

concepts.title: Feature Dependencies
concepts.description: Outlines software, hardware, network dependencies, interworking relationships, and limitations for Data-Aware Carrier Management.

concepts.title: Feature Operation
concepts.description: Describes the operational mechanism of Data-Aware Carrier Management, including demand estimation sampling, threshold-driven class transitions, and SCell lifecycle signaling.

concepts.title: FEATURE OVERVIEW
concepts.description: Overview of Data-Aware Carrier Management, a gNodeB feature that dynamically configures and activates NR carrier aggregation SCells based on per-UE data demand classification.

concepts.title: Network Impact
concepts.description: Overview of the network signaling reductions, user throughput behavior, UE battery savings, and KPI trends associated with Data-Aware Carrier Management.

concepts.title: Parameters
concepts.description: Configuration parameters for Data-Aware Carrier Management including ranges, datatypes, and default values.

concepts.title: Performance Management
concepts.description: Guidance, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and counters for verifying the efficiency and safety of Data-Aware Carrier Management.
